isolatedHtml: Isolated HTML preview. Scripts, forms and network requests are disabled by the security policy.
readShortcuts:
Explorer: arrows, Home/End, type-ahead; Enter opens; Space previews. Ctrl/Cmd+A selects all. Shift extends selection.
Ctrl/Cmd+L edits the address. Backspace or Alt+Up opens the parent. Alt+Left/Right follows history. Ctrl/Cmd+B toggles Locations; add Alt for Inspector.
PDF: j/k or PageDown/PageUp, +/-, / to search; g then a page number and Enter to jump. Quick Look: Left/Right, Escape to close, Enter to open.
Media: Space plays/pauses, arrows seek, f enters fullscreen. Escape closes overlays.
pdfError: Shelf cannot open this PDF. It may be damaged, password-protected or use an unsupported feature. Download to open it in another reader.
mediaError: Playback or fullscreen is unavailable. Download this file to open it in another player.
